comment: "I found the course most interesting because it highlighted how simple practices, like proper hand hygiene and safe medication handling, can significantly reduce hospital-acquired infections. I also appreciated learning evidence-based guidelines from WHO and CDC, and seeing how they apply directly to real-life clinical settings. The practical scenarios and clear explanations made the material engaging and highly relevant to patient safety."

"I found the focus on infection prevention and patient safety most interesting—learning how practices like hand hygiene, PPE use, and safe medication handling can significantly reduce hospital-acquired infections. I also appreciated seeing how evidence-based guidelines and ethical considerations come together in everyday clinical care."

"I found the aspects related to infection prevention and control most interesting, especially the evidence-based practices like the WHO’s 5 moments of hand hygiene, safe injection practices, and central line/urinary catheter bundles. These topics stood out because they are highly practical, directly applicable in daily clinical work, and have a major impact on patient safety and reduction of hospital-acquired infections (HAIs)."

"I found most intersting how small, routine practices can significantly impact patient outcomes and prevent hospital-acquired infections. The real-world relevance of these measures made the course both practical and enlightening. Learning about medication preparation practices, safe catheter use, and central line precautions also deepened my appreciation for the role anesthesiologists and other healthcare providers play in infection prevention."

"What attracted me most in this course was the balance between theoretical and practical aspects. The information was clear and based on the latest research, along with practical exercises that helped me understand the material more deeply. I also appreciated the engaging and interactive way the content was delivered, which motivated me to participate and get the most benefit."

"In this course, I found the understanding of the chain of infection particularly interesting, as it provided a clear framework for how infections spread and how each link can be interrupted to prevent transmission. I also found the discussion on evidence-based practices engaging."

"I found the parts about how infections spread and how healthcare workers can prevent them the most interesting. Learning about proper hand hygiene, using personal protective equipment, and keeping patients safe was very useful. The course helped me understand how important infection control is in healthcare."

"I am a 2nd year general surgery resident in Mexico. Sometimes here in Mexico, we dont take that much importance to hand-washing. It is so important for the patient safety and good outcome in the post OP, and more importantly, because my country is not used to following a lot of clean protocols. Thank you for this kind of course."

"I found the course very interesting because it explained practical infection control steps like hand hygiene, safe IV handling, and waste management in a simple and clear way. The short videos and real-life examples made it easy to understand and remember. I liked that it focused on safety for both patients and healthcare workers."

"The most interesting part of the course was understanding how infections spread in hospitals and how easily they can be prevented. I also found hand hygiene and PPE use very important for protecting both patients and healthcare wokers."
